panels.description: Night at Lake Keel's boathouse. Older Alex grips a mooring post as TJ steps from the dock and separates mid-stride; his granddaughter stands behind him in a blanket. Leave upper band clear for sound lettering.
Close on the granddaughter and Alex; across the lake, a tanker barge and two siphon drones work beneath white lamps. Leave upper corners clear for two balloons.
TJ's head glides ahead while his torso and legs travel independently toward the barge. Leave open water above for lettering.
The granddaughter catches Alex's sleeve while he keeps watching the theft. Leave upper third clear for dialogue.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Let’s see what they came to take.
